body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News & Press Release> LG Electronics MobileComm USA (LG Mobile Phones) is showcasing the latest in mobile handset innovations during CES 2008(Booth #8214, Central Hall, Las Vegas Convention Center).
If sublime style and excellent performance can provide the ultimate mobile experience, then LG Mobile Phones' new ‘Voyager’ makes that ultimate experience a reality.

Besides being the first handset with an interactive touch screen and a full QWERTY keyboard, this one-of-a-kind mobile wonder also provides access to V CAST Mobile TV and provides full HTML Internet browsing.
The Voyager's dual speakers for stereo sound make it the ultimate music player, and it is Bluetooth®-capable and includes a 2.0 megapixel camera and camcorder.
